architecture: Vertical BT30 milling spindle over a trunnion: A tilt -30 to +120 deg carrying C turning spindle (DD motor, table dia 170) with a tail-side support; turning with stationary tools in the milling spindle (double plunger lock). Which unit carries X/Y/Z is not stated on the fetched page (memory says table X on Y saddle with Z head on fixed column, unverified).

control.standard: Brother CNC-D00, 5 axes X,Y,Z,A,C (linear interp 4 axes)

A.indexing_or_full: full; indexing feed 50 rpm; clamp (optional) 800 single / 1080 double N·m

C.indexing_or_full: full; turning spindle max 1500 rpm, 102 N·m max, 9.9 kW max output, motor 4.6 kW; clamp 450 N·m

spindle_nose_type: Table top per ISO 702-4 table nose No.6 (JIS B6109-2)
tailstock: tail-side support on trunnion (load 19 kg: 13 rotating + 6 fixed)

coolant.notes: CTS optional (BT dual-contact spindle used with CTS)

notes: Columns read by position (M200Xd1 & -5AX / M300Xd1 & -5AX). Table-side load 75 kg, tail side 19 kg; load inertia table side 0.8 kg·m², tail 0.04. Tool storage listed as 22/28 (28 shown first; turning tools not in adjacent pods with 28). Tools >=200 mm long may hit jig when magazine turns. M300Xd1 jig turning dia 450 mm (page text). Rotary accuracy 28 arcsec, repeatability 16 arcsec. Floor space W x D excludes coolant tank/conveyor. Successor M300Xd2 listed on site (not read in full: same C standard 2,000 rpm/55 N·m, high-torque 1,500 rpm/102 N·m).
